summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of 6 new category pages (Eletrônicos, Eletrodomésticos, Casa & Cozinha, Vestuário, Beleza & Saúde, Pets). All core features working correctly: navbar dropdown with 6 categories, homepage 'Explore por Categoria' section, automatic search on page load, subcategory filters, dark theme, mobile menu, and Ver Oferta buttons.

issues: react-helmet meta tags are set but may not be visible to search engine crawlers due to client-side rendering. For optimal SEO, consider server-side rendering (SSR) or static site generation (SSG).

passed_tests: Navbar 'Categorias' dropdown shows all 6 categories with icons and descriptions
Homepage 'Explore por Categoria' section displays 6 category cards
/categoria/eletronicos - loads with automatic search, shows 6 subcategories (Celulares, TVs, Notebooks, Fones de Ouvido, Smartwatches, Consoles)
/categoria/eletrodomesticos - loads with automatic search, shows subcategories (Geladeiras, Máquinas de Lavar, Fogões/Cooktops, Micro-ondas, Ar-condicionado, Aspiradores)
/categoria/casa-cozinha - loads with automatic search, shows subcategories (Panelas, Talheres, Utensílios de Cozinha, Cafeteiras, Organização Doméstica, Pratos e Louças, Copos e Taças)
/categoria/vestuario - loads with automatic search, shows subcategories (Tênis, Roupas Masculinas, Roupas Femininas, Calçados, Camisetas, Jaquetas, Vestidos)
/categoria/beleza-saude - loads with automatic search, shows subcategories (Maquiagem, Cuidados com a Pele, Cabelo, Higiene Pessoal, Perfumes, Saúde e Bem-estar)
/categoria/pets - loads with automatic search, shows subcategories (Ração para Cachorro, Ração para Gato, Petiscos, Acessórios Pet, Higiene Pet, Brinquedos Pet)
Automatic search returns 20 products on each category page
Subcategory filter updates URL with ?sub= parameter and filters products
Dark theme toggle works and persists across category pages
Mobile menu displays all 6 categories in 'Categorias' section
Ver Oferta buttons present and clickable on all product cards (20 per page)
Breadcrumb navigation displays correctly (Início > Produtos > Category Name)
Sort dropdown (Menor preço, Maior preço, etc.) present and functional
Grid/List view toggle present on desktop
critical_code_review_comments: SEO meta tags via react-helmet are implemented but only work client-side. For better SEO, consider implementing SSR with Next.js or using react-helmet-async with server rendering.

navigation.mobile_menu: Working - Categories section with all 6 links

The CategoryPage.jsx component is reusable and handles automatic search, subcategory filtering, and search within category. Dark theme works across all pages.
